items.grp_def_sql: select '1900-01-01' begin_date, '2099-12-31' end_date, src_sys_prdno grp_val, fnd_name grp_name from (select src_sys_prdno ,fnd_name ,row_number() over(partition by src_sys_prdno order by src_rec_id desc) as rnk from pdata_news_n.t02_tmc_fin_info where src_id = 'TMC' and grp_id = '01' ) t where rnk=1

items.grp_type_name: 资产托管-市场公募产品
items.grp_def_sql: select '1900-01-01' begin_date, '2099-12-31' end_date, src_sys_prdno grp_val, full_name grp_name from( select a.src_sys_prdno, a.full_name, row_number() over( partition by a.src_sys_prdno order by a.rec_upd_time desc ) as rnk from pdata_news_n.t02_fnd_base_info a join ( select secu_id from pdata_news_n.t02_scr_type where src_id = 'WD' and type_cd like '%200101%' ) b on a.secu_id = b.secu_id where a.src_id = 'WD' ) t where rnk = 1

select '1900-01-01' begin_date, '2099-12-31' end_date, rec_id grp_val, ch_abbr grp_name from (select rec_id, ch_abbr, row_number() over(partition by rec_id order by length(ch_abbr) desc) as rnk from pdata_news_n.t02_scr_base_info where src_id = 'MOT' and rec_id is not null) t where rnk=1

SELECT '1900-01-01' begin_date,'2099-12-31' end_date,Ta_Fnd_Cd AS grp_val,prd_name AS grp_name FROM PDATA_N.T98_CSTD_PRD_TA_INFO WHERE src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TA5.D_TA_TFUNDINFO' AND busi_date=':data_day_str' GROUP BY Ta_Fnd_Cd,prd_name

SELECT '1900-01-01' begin_date,'2099-12-31' end_date,Ta_Fnd_Cd AS grp_val,Prd_Name AS grp_name FROM PDATA_N.T98_CSTD_PRD_TA_INFO WHERE src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_TA5.D_TA_TFUNDINFO' AND ((Stru_Flag='1' AND Prnt_Fnd_Flag ='0') OR Stru_Flag='0') AND busi_date=':data_day_str' GROUP BY Ta_Fnd_Cd,prd_name

select '1900-01-01' begin_date, '2099-12-31' end_date, secu_id as grp_val, if(coalesce(ch_abbr,'')='',ch_name,ch_abbr) as grp_name from ( select secu_id, ch_abbr, ch_name, row_number() over( partition by secu_id order by length(coalesce(ch_abbr,'')) desc,length(coalesce(ch_name,'')) desc ) as seq from pdata_news_n.t02_scr_base_info where src_id in ('WD', 'RCC', 'ICC', 'XLA', 'PO3T') and secu_id is not null ) x where seq = 1
select '1900-01-01' begin_date, '2099-12-31' end_date, secu_id grp_val, max(ch_abbr) grp_name from pdata_news_n.t02_scr_base_info where src_id = 'TA5' and secu_id is not null group by secu_id
select '1900-01-01' begin_date, '2099-12-31' end_date, tgt_secu_id as grp_val, max(stk_name) as grp_name from pdata_news_n.t02_marg_base_info group by tgt_secu_id
